aviation_incidents.headline: 印度A321neo乘客應對頭頂行李櫃行動電源起火 航班改道
aviation_incidents.summary: 印度一架A321neo客機的頭頂行李櫃發生行動電源起火，乘客設法阻止火勢蔓延；飛機被迫改道。現有資訊未說明航空公司及事件日期。
aviation_incidents.headline_en: Passengers battle overhead-bin power bank fire aboard Indian A321neo as flight diverts
aviation_incidents.summary_en: Passengers aboard an Indian A321neo battled a power bank fire in an overhead bin and tried to stop the flames from spreading; the aircraft was forced to divert. The available information does not identify the airline or occurrence date.

aviation_incidents.headline: 漢莎航空747-8在洛杉磯機場避開尾撞 機師中止降落後延誤近半小時落地
aviation_incidents.summary: 漢莎航空一架波音747-8在洛杉磯機場（LAX）降落時，機師中止降落，飛機驚險避開尾撞；該機最終較表定時間晚不到半小時落地。
aviation_incidents.headline_en: Lufthansa 747-8 avoids tail strike at LAX as pilots abort landing and aircraft lands just under half an hour late
aviation_incidents.summary_en: Pilots of a Lufthansa Boeing 747-8 aborted the landing at Los Angeles International Airport (LAX), and the aircraft narrowly avoided a tail strike. It eventually touched down just under half an hour behind schedule.

sources.name: Simple Flying — Lufthansa Boeing 747-8 Escapes Tail Strike By Inches At LAX…

taiwan_aviation.headline: 華航桃園往返香港航班10月25日起改用桃園機場第二航廈 報到與行李提領同步調整
taiwan_aviation.summary: 華航桃園往返香港航班自2026年10月25日起改於桃園機場第二航廈營運，報到、出入境及行李提領也移至第二航廈辦理。旅客應依出發或抵達航班確認航廈資訊。
taiwan_aviation.headline_en: China Airlines Taoyuan–Hong Kong flights move to Terminal 2 from October 25, with passenger procedures relocated
taiwan_aviation.summary_en: From October 25, 2026, China Airlines flights between Taoyuan and Hong Kong will operate from Terminal 2 at Taoyuan Airport. Check-in, immigration procedures and baggage claim will also move there; passengers should check the terminal for their flight.

taiwan_aviation.headline: 星宇航空9月營收年增69% 客運與貨運營收均成長
taiwan_aviation.summary: 星宇航空9月營收為新臺幣49.75億元，年增69%；客運營收年增70%，貨運營收年增59%。公司表示貨運市場需求增溫，並看好後續市場。
taiwan_aviation.headline_en: Starlux September revenue rises 69% year on year as passenger and cargo revenue grow
taiwan_aviation.summary_en: Starlux Airlines reported September revenue of NT$4.975 billion, up 69% year on year. Passenger revenue rose 70% and cargo revenue rose 59% year on year. The airline said air-cargo demand was strengthening and expressed optimism about the market.

international_aviation.headline: 美國陸軍七月沙漠演習測試無人機與指揮系統 暴露裝備限制
international_aviation.summary: 美國陸軍七月在莫哈維沙漠舉行演習，測試無人機、指揮系統及其他新興技術；報導指出演習暴露裝備限制，包括伺服器過熱與電池無法充電。
international_aviation.headline_en: US Army desert exercise tests drones and command systems, exposing equipment limits
international_aviation.summary_en: The US Army tested drones, command systems and other emerging technologies in a July exercise in the Mojave Desert. The exercise exposed equipment limitations, including overheated servers and batteries that could not be recharged.

international_aviation.headline: 阿拉斯加航空將於2027年退役737-700客機 改由737-800接替
international_aviation.summary: 阿拉斯加航空計畫於2027年退役客運機隊中的波音737-700，並以較大型737-800接替，目標是在阿拉斯加增加座位與貨運空間。
international_aviation.headline_en: Alaska Airlines to retire 737-700 passenger fleet in 2027 and replace it with 737-800s
international_aviation.summary_en: Alaska Airlines plans to retire its Boeing 737-700 passenger fleet in 2027 and replace the aircraft with larger 737-800s in Alaska. The intended benefits include more seats and cargo space.

international_aviation.headline: Avolon宣布訂購250架空巴與波音新機 訂單仍待股東批准
international_aviation.summary: 飛機租賃公司Avolon宣布訂購250架新機，包括140架波音737 MAX及110架空中巴士飛機；空巴部分為75架A320neo系列與35架A330neo系列。訂單仍待持有Avolon七成股權的Bohai Leasing批准；另有100架空巴選擇權，並非確定訂單。
international_aviation.headline_en: Avolon announces orders for 250 Airbus and Boeing aircraft, pending shareholder approval
international_aviation.summary_en: Aircraft lessor Avolon announced orders for 250 new aircraft: 140 Boeing 737 MAX jets and 110 Airbus aircraft, comprising 75 A320neo-family and 35 A330neo-family aircraft. The orders remain subject to approval by Bohai Leasing, which owns 70% of Avolon. A separate option covers 100 additional Airbus aircraft and is not a firm order.

international_aviation.headline: 西班牙直升機營運商Eliance申請初步債權人保護 未來取決於協商結果
international_aviation.summary: 西班牙直升機營運商Eliance已申請初步債權人保護。公司2025財年淨虧損由前一年的€12 million增至€24 million，營收約€54 million；公司有意繼續營運，未來取決於與債權人的協商。
international_aviation.headline_en: Spanish helicopter operator Eliance files for preliminary creditor protection as its future depends on talks
international_aviation.summary_en: Spanish helicopter operator Eliance has filed for preliminary creditor protection. Its fiscal 2025 net loss doubled from €12 million to €24 million, while revenue was approximately €54 million. The company intends to continue operating, but its future depends on negotiations with creditors.

international_aviation.headline: 希斯洛機場稱逾40家航空公司尋求時段 擴建與第三跑道呼聲升高
international_aviation.summary: 希斯洛機場表示，超過40家航空公司正尋求機場時段，需求持續超過可用容量；機場管理層稱，航空公司因此被迫選擇海外競爭樞紐。機場主張擴建可容納新航空公司與航線，並增加競爭。
international_aviation.headline_en: Heathrow says more than 40 airlines seek slots as calls for expansion and a third runway intensify
international_aviation.summary_en: Heathrow says more than 40 airlines are seeking airport slots, with demand continuing to exceed available capacity. Airport management says this is forcing airlines to choose competing overseas hubs. The airport argues that expansion could make room for new airlines and routes and increase competition.

international_aviation.headline: 空中巴士U740 Valkyrie無人戰鬥機完成歐洲首飛 達成測試目標
international_aviation.summary: 空中巴士U740 Valkyrie無人戰鬥機在北歐測試設施完成歐洲首次飛行，空中巴士表示飛機達成各項目標。測試包括火箭助推起飛、不同高度飛行及最高Mach 0.8；公司稱此次飛行為搭載MARS任務系統的後續測試鋪路。
international_aviation.headline_en: Airbus U740 Valkyrie uncrewed combat aircraft completes first European flight and meets test objectives
international_aviation.summary_en: The Airbus U740 Valkyrie uncrewed combat aircraft completed its first European flight at a Northern European test facility. Airbus said it met the objectives, including a rocket-assisted takeoff, maneuvers at different altitudes and speeds of up to Mach 0.8. The flight paves the way for further tests with the MARS mission system.
